title: Extend the design system with a documented capability
description:
Problem/Goal: add the explicitly missing system capability.
Key actions: define API, migrate consumers, document, and verify.
Out of scope: unrelated visual redesign.
Success criteria: compatibility, stories/tests, migration impact, and docs are complete.
objective: Deliver an intentional design-system extension or migration.
result: A documented and verified system capability with downstream rollout plan.
steps: Validate migration impact and update docs.
acceptance_criteria: The capability API, migration impact, tests/stories, and documentation are complete.
